propositions: Attestation staleness messages name a fictional fixed list ('description/AC/file_impact/children') instead of identifying which component actually changed.

Ticking an AC checkbox does not invalidate an attestation because checkbox state is normalized out by _normalize_checkbox_state before hashing; pre-330c attestations hashing raw descriptions produce false staleness on checkbox-only edits.
Per-component fingerprints (hash16 and size count) must be signed in the manifest and recorded on the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar to support component-wise diff explanation without replaying event history.

Attestation refusal surfaces across generation.py, resign.py, completion.py, attest_gate.py, and _llm_commands.py must consistently forward or compute the component-named reason, and relation-snapshot read failures at signing time must not advise re-signing.
Documentation (plan-review-gate.md and plan_review_verdict.schema.json) must correct the basis key list and state plainly that checkbox ticking is attestation-safe.

Gate outcomes and verdicts (valid/verdict pair for unsigned, not-closed, stale-reopened, wrong-kind, stale-material) remain unchanged; all edits are diagnostic-only reason strings or additive manifest lines.
